Harmanpreet Kaur achieves historic feat at Lord's

Indian cricketer Harmanpreet Kaur has made history at Lord's by scoring a half-century in all three formats of the game. This achievement places her in an elite category, with reports noting that even prominent male cricketers like Sachin Tendulkar and Virat Kohli have not accomplished this specific feat at Lord's. The accomplishment is being highlighted as a significant moment in women's cricket.
